gaps.explanation: deny + -ing or having + past participle: denied doing/having done. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: He went on ___ even after the audience had left.
gaps.explanation: go on + -ing = continue the same activity; go on to do = do something next.

gaps.sentence: The witness claims ___ the getaway car parked outside for an hour.
gaps.explanation: 'Claims to have seen' — the perfect infinitive marks an earlier action.

gaps.sentence: He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Don't forget ___ off the lights when you leave.
gaps.explanation: forget + to-infinitive = fail to do a duty: forget to turn.

gaps.sentence: It's not worth ___ over spilt milk.

gaps.explanation: happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.
